mentions.name: peek
mentions.description: A minimal CLI network monitor for uptime-style checks, offering a smaller, terminal-based alternative to Uptime Kuma.
mentions.problem: The author couldn't find an existing solution that did what was needed — something like Uptime Kuma, but smaller and in the CLI.
mentions.source_excerpt: Before that, I vibe coded peek – a CLI network monitor, just because I couldn't find a solution that did what I needed it to do (think Uptime Kuma, but less and in CLI). You can try it out from here: https://github.com/hxii/peek
